title: Unit Event — Backlight, Lens Flare

meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's next step is to appear as extras in a film! Each of them is enthusiastic about this opportunity to work their magic on camera, and Rui is particularly eager to learn about a different type of directing. However, not everything goes smoothly...

rows.Line: Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, we're here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is where the shoot for the film's taking place...!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: We might need to shoot this scene from a different angle since it's sunnier than we were expecting.

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
Can you bring the reflector board over?
I'd like to test to see how the sea looks in the background.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, they've already started getting ready!
The camera crew looks busy busy busy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to see so many people working on this film. I'd heard that it was only going to be shown in select mini theaters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I shot one with my class recently, but this is for real. It feels nothing like what we did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This might sound obvious, but everyone's so professional. I can almost feel it in the air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm suddenly feeling extremely excited!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, getting to take my first step into the world of motion pictures is—

Ah, Tenma, everyone...
You're all here on day one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
That voice...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Uhh... It's nice to see you all again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Bakuno!
Good wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us this wonderful opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since you'll be playing the lead, we promise to do absolutely everything in our power to make sure you shine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, we're just extras and only here for one day... But it's not every day that you get to be in a film like this, so I wanna do my best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Again, thank you for inviting us.
We all promise to do our very best.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
N-No, you don't need to thank me like this!
All I did was mention how this film needed a few more extras.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Also... You've all helped me quite a lot by being here. I was actually feeling really nervous about this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it is your first time playing the lead in a film. You must be under a lot of pressure.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And super duper excited!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not so sure about that last part...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Haha. Actually, Otori's correct in saying that I'm also a little excited about this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: While I'm nervous about my first time in a long time playing the lead, it'll be my first time acting on camera...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: It's been a nice chance for me to learn how acting in this medium is different.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How it's different...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you—
Hey, everyone, we're starting once the cameras are all set up! We roll in ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Looks like they're about to get started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, was that the director of this film...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes, his name is Tomomi Ohara.
He's still young for a director, in his mid-thirties, but he's well regarded within the industry for his talent.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: He's still relatively unknown, but others have told me how it's only a matter of time until he gets his big break.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We watched a few of his previous works, and I was impressed by how carefully he presents the feelings and emotional states of his characters.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, “A Sound For Farewell” and “The Night The Whales Sing” were particularly good. I couldn't help but feel moved by each of the protagonists' situations!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The story for each one was good, but I also thought the cinematography was really beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's an honor to get to work under a director who makes such wonderful films!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, however... I'm not sure if I should be saying this, but I've heard that he can become a bit overzealous while shooting a film...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Overzealous...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Yes, he does have a slight habit of asking too much of the cast and staff. Also, please try not to be alarmed when you hear some harsh words come out of him.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But it's all for the sake of making a good film. Those who've seen things through to the end with him all place deep trust in him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In other words, his desire to create a good film can go a bit too far.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It may not be something to be proud of, but I think I share that sentiment...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In any case, we just need to give this chance everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
We gotta learn what we can and put it into practice moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna learn all about how you actually make films in real life like Grandpa and Mr. Riley did!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna make the most of this opportunity by learning as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: What you've all just said has kind of given me a bit of courage.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I also promise to do my best.
They're probably going to need me soon, so let's talk again once it's over...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sounds good. Thank you for going out of your way to chat with us. We know you're a very busy person.
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Based on what the director said earlier, they're probably gonna get started in about five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, we should also start getting ready!
But what do we actually need to do?

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Okay, will the extras for Scene 15 please gather over here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, there's our cue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Scene 15 is our time to shine! Our chance has finally arrived!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's go, everyone!
We need to leave our mark as the best extras ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
We're gonna make history!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Make history? As extras...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We've never received this kind of opportunity before, so the experience we gain today should be invaluable.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is a director who knows how to make very moving films, and we get to see him work up close.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, we'll get to see Bakuno perform for the silver screen instead of on the stage.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I stand to learn quite a lot as a director.)
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's good that we're all excited, but it looks like they won't be shooting Scene 15 for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, they just wanted to make sure we knew where we'd all be standing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's hard not to get excited.
But I suppose we should take this time to relax and prepare for when it is our turn.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also... Look.
They've started shooting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...!
It's really starting... Like for real!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent!
I'm very much looking forward to seeing how this story looks on the big screen!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The title for this film is “A Flower Grows In The Shade”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist, Katsuyuki, has been living a banal existence with no real hopes for the future. Then, a woman named Hajime, calling herself his “long-lost sister”, suddenly appears before him and helps him find joy in life again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm curious to see how his feelings are presented in this film since it's going to require a deft hand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It starts with him lying around at home doing nothing, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait a second... They can't really shoot that scene here, can they...?

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Alright, this is it! Let's start rolling!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: And... Action!
se_event_lensflare_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “*Sigh*”

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “Wait!”

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “It isn't safe to stare into the ocean like that. I think you should stop.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Who are you...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Isn't this the scene where they talk for the first time? They aren't starting from the very beginning...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I get it now!
You don't start by shooting the very first scene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see. You were wondering why they weren't exactly following the script.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Normally, we just start from the top and work our way through.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More often than not when you're making moving, you have to shoot all the scenes for one location at once, since you can't keep booking the site and having the cast come back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, they're gonna shoot all the scenes that take place here in Yokohama today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely. There are three scenes, I believe. Scene 7, the one Bakuno is currently doing, where he meets his character's sister. Then Scene 15, where we appear...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And finally, Scene 72, towards the end. Where the protagonist goes out searching for his sister after she disappears.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you think about it, the way you shoot a film is kinda weird. I mean, they're jumping all the way from Scene 7 to Scene 72.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, order doesn't seem to matter.
You can go from the beginning to the climax in a flash...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means the cast members need to be able to change what they're feeling based on each scene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, in Scene 7, the one they're on right now... Katsuyuki should be feeling cautious or wary of this person suddenly calling herself his long-lost sister...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And by Scene 72, they'll have gotten to know each other so well that he feels compelled to come here looking for her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means Bakuno will have to take into consideration what Katsuyuki should be feeling in each situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, he has to make sure there are no inconsistencies with today's performances when he's working on the other scenes at a later date.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yikes...
That sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...
It's even harder than I imagined...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Looks like they're already learning new things.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Actually, they're not alone.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, there's so much to keep track of...
Where you're gonna shoot each day, which actors are scheduled to be there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So is Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Katsuyuki in this scene is still stunted emotionally and blames the world for all his problems. That means I should play him with a coarse way of speaking as we discussed... But this nuance here is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even for Bakuno, this may prove a big challenge.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should also be doing my best to learn as much as I can.)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work.
This day really flew by, but it was a fruitful one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The use of lighting was just one example of the great deal of attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I also learned a lot!
Like what happens when you actually shoot a film and how many people you need to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we all did a great job as extras!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well...
You all did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're still beating yourself up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course I am!
I tirelessly practiced squatting while admiring flowers as Young Man A just for today...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But when we shot that scene for real, that bug...! It landed on my hand and made me flinch...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which forced us to do another take... I'm never going to forget what happened today! I'll regret it for the rest of my life!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Quit blowing things out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may only deepen your fear of bugs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still... As wonderful as this experience was, it's a shame that it only lasted one day.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was sort of hoping that we'd be allowed to stay on set a little while longer, but—)
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...! Hi, Bakuno!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Congratulations on finishing your first day, Bakuno.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was stunned by the contrast between Scenes 7 and 72 in how Katsuyuki looked at his sister... You did such an amazing job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! He started out all grumpy-wumpy in the first scene, but he seemed so happy in the other one! I really wanna know how he gets there!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it.
I wasn't sure how things would go after I froze up a little in the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you managed to solve that problem after hearing Mr. Ohara's advice. The way you're able to adapt is really something else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were just talking about how much we learned today. Tsukasa even—
What's this? Our star seems to have himself surrounded.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mr. Ohara...!
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Now I see...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: So, you're all training with different troupes in order to make your dreams come true, which is what led you to Shunmeiza and Bakuno.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
He told us about the opportunity to be extras in this film...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We learned so much today!
Thank you very much for having us!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful to hear.
However...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Hmm...
After hearing your story, I'd like to ask you all something...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: How would you like to work as part of this film's production crew?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: As embarrassing as it is for me to say this, we've recently started feeling a bit shorthanded.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: You won't be able to perform as actors, but your help would be greatly appreciated. Of course, you'll be paid for your work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
This would be an unbelievable learning experience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this?
We'll need some guidance since we've never worked on a film before.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sure.
Your tasks will be relatively simple.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, I wanna help!
We'd get to learn so much more about how films are made!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd like to as well.
I wanna spend more time watching the cast at work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
We won't be visiting our next troupe for some time, so I'd like to take this opportunity to learn as much as I can about directing a film.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, if you don't mind having us...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
I'm so glad that you're agreeing to join.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Then, can you all come tomorrow?
The rest of the crew will give you all the details. They should be just over there, so if you can give them your contact information for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Then, I'm off to look over everything we shot today. I'm looking forward to seeing you all back here tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: You too, Bakuno. Try to get some rest since I know the sea air gave your throat a tough time!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you, I will...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who saw this coming?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Luck be with us! Fortune has favored us!
Let's come back tomorrow and continue to learn as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. Opportunities like this don't come around often, so we need to try to make the most of it.
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had no idea that this person was behind it all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I didn't either!
I mean, they seemed so friendly!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! If this person was behind it all, then that means the way he was so friendly to the hero was all an act!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow...
Now I wanna see that scene again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Rin.
I love how fascinated you are by the movie the others brought over!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, it's just so good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Especially that car chase towards the end!
My heart wouldn't stop racing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently, they closed down part of a real road to shoot that scene.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Then, those were real people zooming around in real cars?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It's common to use CGI these days, but that was all real.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow...!
You can't do any of that stuff with stage shows...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And now you guys get to work on a real-live film... That's so cool...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It really is.
Still, Nene, that film you made with your classmates was startlingly good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, you're comparing apples to oranges.
We're talking about a professionally made film here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The crew's huge, and the equipment they're using is on a completely different level.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Now I'm really interested!
I wanna know what it's like to shoot a film.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're that interested, then why don't you come visit us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be an invaluable experience for all of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you've gotta stay quiet so that the others don't see you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks☆
Then, I'll go take a peek sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Still, talk about being lucky.
I mean, you get to help produce a real film.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes... But we still don't actually know what we'll be doing yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, since the director was kind enough to invite us along, we won't be allowed to cut any corners!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm ready to do the best I can!
You can leave all the heavy lifting to me♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Good luck, everyone!
I'll be rooting for you☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how the film turns out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
We'll do our best to make it a good one.
A few weeks later
Rental Room in Tokyo

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
This stand should be good here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's been about two weeks since we started helping with this film.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The film itself has been coming along nicely, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Are the flowers all in place?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
I put them right where you said to!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: No, the light hits it all wrong with them faced this way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Forget it... Can I get a tech over here to readjust this light?!

rows.Speaker: Lighting Crew Member
rows.Line: On it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I got yelled at again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hanging in there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Bakuno warned us about the director being hard to please, but this goes a bit beyond that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our “relatively simple” tasks turned out to be things like moving around heavy equipment and getting permission to film at various locations. “Relatively hard” is more like it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I heard a rumor that a few part-timers stopped coming the day before he asked us to join...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. The way he treats his crew may've pushed them to leave...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means he needed us to replace them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's likely the case.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
Rui, you knew?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The way he said, “We've just started feeling a bit shorthanded,” when he invited us to join caught my attention.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For that to have happened in the middle of the production process, I suspected that something must have happened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wait, why didn't you tell us this sooner...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I had no proof.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also...
I didn't see any reason to refuse his offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've all learned quite a lot while working on this film these past couple of weeks, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, as hard as things have been, we have learned a lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've gotten to watch all the actors perform up close, and see the director work with them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I've learned a ton from the crew about the whole production process, like how proposals for films actually get off the ground!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that sense, everything we've done has been meaningful in some way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, let's get back to work!
I need to start preparing for the next scene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right!
Nene, let's go help the catering team with the lunches!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you later then, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Alright, I should also get back to where I'm supposed to be.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to check over all the props we'll be using this afternoon... We'll be taking our break after the next scene, so I should try to finish before then.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And if I finish early, I might be able to talk to Mr. Ohara about what's been on my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to learn more about directing by actually being by his side, but I'm in no position to make such a request.)

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Okay, onto the next scene... Wait.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Hey, this script's old! What's it doing here?! I almost mistook it for the latest version!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, this is the right one.
I put it there earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No, this isn't it.
Didn't I say this morning that these lines needed fixing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, which is why I decided to also include the old script.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be easier to have something to compare against?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
...
Oh, here it is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you don't need it, then I'll leave you with just the latest one.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
